name: Xr3azn Network
notes:
AS218681 — Xr3azn Network (Seoul, KR)

**Network type:** NSP (not a personal network). We provide **IP transit and hosting** services.
**Presence:** Seoul (cloud edge) · IXs: KCIXP (Seoul), remote 4IXP, EVIX, ixFabric (Tokyo, Düsseldorf, Bogotá).
**Address families:** IPv6 today; IPv4 to be added with our data-centre move.

**Peering:** Open. Bilateral sessions welcome (IX or private interconnect / WireGuard).
**AS-SET:** RIPE::AS218681:AS-CUSTOMERS · **Max-prefix (IPv6):** 10

**Routing security:** RPKI ROV (invalid = reject), ASPA path verification (invalid = reject),
ASPA published, IRR-based exact filtering, bogon/path-length/Tier-1 leak filters, RFC 9234 roles,
BCP 38/84 anti-spoofing, default-free edge (rejected destinations are unreachable at our edge),
graceful shutdown (65535:0) honoured.

**Communities:** informational 218681:1:x (1 own, 2 customer, 3 peer, 4 RS, 5 transit),
218681:2:<ISO3166>, 218681:3:<ASN>; customer actions 218681:0:0 / 218681:0:ASN (no export),
218681:101-103:0 / :ASN (prepend 1-3x). Full list: see our policy documents.

**Abuse:** abuse@xr3azn.com
